# nobus_database_credentials (Data Source)

Reads connection credentials for a Nobus managed database. Credentials are stored in Terraform state as sensitive values.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_id` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `customer_name` (String, Sensitive)
- `customer_password` (String, Sensitive)
- `database_name` (String)
- `database_type` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `install_type` (String)
- `instances_json` (String, Sensitive)
- `status` (String)
- `volume_size` (Number)
